raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 re-delivered 333 transactions a second time at 05:00 with txn_ts as epoch milliseconds (e.g. '1768716039000', which equals 2026-01-18 06:00:39 UTC) instead of the ISO string, and these duplicates break the TIMESTAMP cast. Normalizing epoch-ms strings to timestamps and keeping one row per txn_id yields the same data as the original batch-13/14 rows, with no double counting.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH s AS (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]+$') THEN make_timestamp(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT) * 1000) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, ingest_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts) = 1) SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM s;"}}
